audit: Old source URL (/hol/faq/sizecharts.html) is gone; the official chart is the product-page Size Guide (region UK, cm). Men's tops chart gives UK size and chest range only (plus arm length), so waist, US and EU are removed. Old UK mapping and chests were off: M UK 36-38 chest 93 -> UK 38-40, 95-103; L UK 38-40 chest 99 -> UK 42, 103-110; XL chest 105 -> 110-118; XXL 112 -> 118-126. XXS and XXXL added.

Old source was a stockist (McElhinneys); now read on jackjones.com/en-gb. Chest (TOPS chart) was already right (92-120). Waist comes from the same page's BOTTOMS table, whose 'Sweat pants & shorts' row keys the pant-waist column by the same letter sizes (XS = W28 = 76 cm ... XXL = W38 = 101 cm); old waists were 1-3 cm off (XS 78 -> 76, L 90 -> 91, XL 97 -> 96, XXL 104 -> 101). UK/EU/US removed: JACK & JONES only gives UK/EU equivalents for tailoring (EU 44-60), not for letter-size tops.

Old /gb/size-guide URL 404s; the official chart is the product-page 'Body Measurements' panel (read for every size in its selector). Old labels were one Lacoste number off: Lacoste pairs XS = 2, S = 3, M = 4 (old XS/3, S/4, M/5). Values are Lacoste's own cm figures (chest single value, waist = 'pant waist circumference', a range for S-2XL); Lacoste's inch figures beside them are ranges that don't convert exactly (e.g. S chest 93 cm vs 35-37 in), so the cm values are stored as printed. Old M chest 101 / waist 86 now M/4 = 101 / 85-89; XL 111 -> 117. Sizes 3XL-2XG (8-11) added. UK/US/EU removed (not published in the men's chart).

Old source was a third-party retailer (Barry's). Official men's tops chart gives chest only (XS-XXL; XXS and 3XL-5XL have no measurements); waist and hip come from the men's bottoms letter-size chart on the same page for the same letters, as done for lululemon-w. Chest was nearly right (L 107 -> 106.5); waist was rounded (L 89 -> 88.9, XL 97 -> 96.5); hips added. UK/US/EU removed: lululemon's men's tops chart lists letters in every country row, not numeric UK/EU sizes.

Stored source was a third-party retailer (skirack.com). The men's guide page did not render its charts in the browser this run, so the tables were read from the content assets the page loads from Patagonia's own site (size-mens-tops-data and size-mens-bottoms-alpha-data on eu.patagonia.com), as for patagonia-w. Chest and hip from the Tops chart; waist from the Bottoms (Alpha) chart for the same letters (the Tops chart has no waist). The two charts' hips differ slightly at L-XXXL (e.g. L 109 tops vs 107 bottoms); the Tops value is stored. Old values were 2-6 cm off: S chest 91 -> 94, M 99 -> 102, L 109 -> 112, XXL 129 -> 127; M waist 81 -> 84. XXS and XXXL added; UK/US/EU removed (not published).
